abstract.t:
The Bundle Transfer Protocol - Unidirectional (BTPU) provides for the transfer of large binary objects, typically Bundle Protocol version 7 bundles, over a unidirectional, unreliable, frame-based link-layer protocol, and by design includes no return path.
This document defines the Bundle Transfer Protocol - Cross-Link (BTPX), an extension to BTPU for deployments where independent BTPU channels exist in both directions between a pair of nodes. It defines how a Transfer or a Bundle Message on one channel is referenced from another, and a first application of such references, the Transfer Status Message, which allows a receiver to indicate to a sender that continued transfer of an object is unnecessary, and why.
This document defines no segment-level acknowledgement or retransmission semantics; such mechanisms are deferred to future documents.
